items.summary: Research question (from D-P1): predict material band gap (eV) from composition + structure. RATIFIED at paradigm level; restated here.
Entity-class scope: crystalline inorganic materials (a composition+structure). Q: include 2D/amorphous/molecular crystals, or crystalline-inorganic only?
ML task = REGRESSION on continuous band_gap_value (eV). Follows from D-P1.
Primary regression target: band_gap_value (eV). Q: fundamental vs optical vs transport gap? include direct/indirect as an attribute?
Entity identity: reduced chemical formula + space group + a canonical structure id (Materials Project mp-id and/or ICSD). Q: which id scheme is authoritative?
Conditioning variables: temperature (band gaps are T-dependent), pressure. Q: which conditions are in scope as features?
Unit of analysis: one row = one (material, gap-type, method, condition_set, source). Q: confirm the tuple.
Unit normalization: band gap -> eV; store raw+normalized. No derived threshold (regression).
Vocab bindings: chemical formula (Hill/reduced), space-group number (1-230), Materials Project / ICSD ids, DFT functional controlled list.
Dual adapter: literature (materials papers) + structured (Materials Project; optionally OQMD/AFLOW). Q: which structured DB(s) authoritative + pinned version.

CRITICAL modality axis: DFT-computed vs experimental band gaps must NOT be pooled. Q: experimental-only default tier + DFT as a separate stratum (mirrors #2 E11)? and which DFT functionals admissible (PBE underestimates; HSE/GW closer)?
Composite/relational coupling: doped materials = host+dopant. Q: one entity (doped composition) or host entity + dopant relation? Metals (gap=0) included/excluded?
